nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Triggers at 8:00 AM ET on Mondays for weekly sprint planning

nodes.name: Fetch TRADE Backlog

options.jql: project = TRADE AND sprint is EMPTY AND status != Done ORDER BY priority DESC, created ASC

nodes.notes: Fetches top 10 backlog items from TRADE project

nodes.name: Fetch INFRA Backlog

options.jql: project = INFRA AND sprint is EMPTY AND status != Done ORDER BY priority DESC, created ASC

nodes.notes: Fetches top 10 backlog items from INFRA project

nodes.name: Fetch LEARN Backlog

options.jql: project = LEARN AND sprint is EMPTY AND status != Done ORDER BY priority DESC, created ASC

nodes.notes: Fetches top 10 backlog items from LEARN project

nodes.name: Fetch MGMT Backlog

options.jql: project = MGMT AND sprint is EMPTY AND status != Done ORDER BY priority DESC, created ASC

nodes.notes: Fetches top 10 backlog items from MGMT project

nodes.name: Fetch Last Week Completed

options.jql: status changed to Done AFTER -7d ORDER BY resolved DESC

nodes.notes: Fetches issues completed in the last 7 days to calculate velocity

nodes.name: Fetch Trading Performance
nodes.notes: Fetches last week's trading data for context

nodes.name: Merge All Data
nodes.notes: Combines all parallel backlog and velocity data

nodes.name: Calculate Velocity
nodes.notes: Calculates velocity from last week and prepares sprint proposal data

nodes.name: Generate Sprint Proposal
nodes.notes: Uses Claude to generate intelligent sprint proposal based on velocity and backlogs

nodes.name: Format Proposal Message
nodes.notes: Formats the AI-generated proposal into a Discord embed with reaction prompt

nodes.name: Post Proposal to Discord

parameters.content:
:mega: **Sprint Planning Proposal**

Please review the sprint proposal below and react:
- :white_check_mark: to **APPROVE** and create sprints
- :x: to **REJECT** and notify for manual planning

nodes.notes: Posts the sprint proposal to #ceo-briefing for approval

nodes.name: Add Reactions
nodes.notes: Adds approval reaction to message

nodes.name: Add Reject Reaction
nodes.notes: Adds reject reaction to message

nodes.name: Wait for Response
nodes.notes: Waits up to 60 minutes for approval reaction or webhook callback

nodes.name: Check Approval Status
nodes.notes: Routes based on approval status - approved, rejected, or timeout

nodes.name: Create TRADE Sprint

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "name": "TRADE Sprint Week {{ $('Calculate Velocity').first().json.weekNumber }}",
  "startDate": "{{ $('Calculate Velocity').first().json.sprintStart }}T09:00:00.000Z",
  "endDate": "{{ $('Calculate Velocity').first().json.sprintEnd }}T17:00:00.000Z",
  "originBoardId": {{ process.env.JIRA_TRADE_BOARD_ID || 1 }},
  "goal": "Sprint created by n8n automation - Week {{ $('Calculate Velocity').first().json.weekNumber }}"
}

nodes.notes: Creates a new sprint in TRADE project

nodes.name: Create INFRA Sprint

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "name": "INFRA Sprint Week {{ $('Calculate Velocity').first().json.weekNumber }}",
  "startDate": "{{ $('Calculate Velocity').first().json.sprintStart }}T09:00:00.000Z",
  "endDate": "{{ $('Calculate Velocity').first().json.sprintEnd }}T17:00:00.000Z",
  "originBoardId": {{ process.env.JIRA_INFRA_BOARD_ID || 2 }},
  "goal": "Sprint created by n8n automation - Week {{ $('Calculate Velocity').first().json.weekNumber }}"
}

nodes.notes: Creates a new sprint in INFRA project

nodes.name: Notify Sprint Created

parameters.content:
:white_check_mark: **Sprint Planning Approved**

Created sprints for Week {{ $('Calculate Velocity').first().json.weekNumber }}:
- TRADE Sprint: Ready
- INFRA Sprint: Ready

Backlog items can now be moved into the new sprints.

*Automated by WF-A06*

nodes.notes: Notifies that sprints were created successfully

nodes.name: Notify Rejection

parameters.content:
:x: **Sprint Planning Rejected**

The sprint proposal for Week {{ $('Calculate Velocity').first().json.weekNumber }} was rejected.

Manual sprint planning is required.

*Automated by WF-A06*

nodes.notes: Notifies Chief that sprint was rejected

nodes.name: Notify Timeout

parameters.content:
:hourglass: **Sprint Planning Timed Out**

No response received within 60 minutes for Week {{ $('Calculate Velocity').first().json.weekNumber }} sprint proposal.

Sprints were NOT created. Manual intervention required.

*Automated by WF-A06*

nodes.notes: Notifies Chief that approval timed out

nodes.name: Log Planning Result
nodes.notes: Logs the sprint planning result to audit trail

nodes.name: Workflow Complete
nodes.notes: End node - sprint planning completed

nodes.name: Error Handler
nodes.notes: Catches any errors in this workflow

nodes.name: Post Error
nodes.notes: Posts error to #n8n-errors channel
